previous_versions.body: I humbly suggest "has defenses against ~~HTTP~~ parameter and body pollution attacks" and remove "environment variables" from this requirement. I would say that if a client-side environment variable gets passed, it's a parameter/body variable. If an environment variable is used on the server side, it would be a configuration issue.
